title: Conformance-authority list
description: The public, dated list of conformance authorities: the only way to admit a signer of conformance attestations. Each dated BACP release publishes it as source/registry/conformance-authorities.json, and the release manifest source/handlers/release.json records its digest. It ships empty. An entry is added only as GOVERNANCE.md requires. A Mandate Manager may narrow the list by publishing an exclusion list and MUST NOT add to it.

ca_id.description: The authority's id. It is the iss of the attestations that it signs.

kind.description: An independent test laboratory, or a rail-sponsor bank listed at its own request. For display only: it grants no extra power, and a bank is never the required signer.

name.description: The legal name of the entity that operates the authority.

id.description: The entity's registration identifier, for example a CIN. A Mandate Manager compares this operator with the operators of the attested subject, of the payer PSP and of itself, to check separation.

group_id.description: OPTIONAL. The registry-assigned group id of the operator, compared as in registry-record.json.

operator.description: The legal entity that operates the authority.

name.description: The legal name of the funding organisation.

id.description: The funder's registration identifier, for example a CIN. A Mandate Manager compares it with the operators of the attested subject, of the payer PSP and of itself, as it does the operator's.

funders.description: The organisations that fund the authority's conformance work, each as {name, id}. Empty when there are none.

keys.description: The public keys of the authority. An attestation verifies only against one of these keys, identified by the kid of its JOSE header.

levels.description: The conformance levels that the authority may attest.

pilots.description: The pilot payment handlers that the authority may list in an attestation's pilots[]. Every entry is scoped: a pilot outside this list is refused.

scope.description: What the authority may attest. A Mandate Manager refuses an attestation whose levels or pilots fall outside it.

report_uri_template.description: A URI template for the published run report behind an attestation, so that its report_digest can be checked.

valid_until.description: When the entry lapses unless renewed.

status.description: Where the entry's revocation status is published. The registry publishes and signs it, never the authority itself.

funder_ids.description: OPTIONAL. The registration identifiers of the funders, when they have them. The separation check covers every funder: a Mandate Manager refuses an attestation when the operator of the gateway, of the payer PSP or of the Mandate Manager shares an entity with a funder, as it does for the operator.

fee_model.description: How the authority is paid for a run. No fee depends on the result, and no fee is payable to the project for a list entry.

basis.description: per_run: a fee for each conformance run. subscription: a fixed fee for a period, whatever the number of runs.

outcome_contingent.description: Always false: the authority's fee never depends on whether the subject passes.

terms_uri.description: Where the authority publishes its fee terms.

publishes_all_runs.description: Always true: the authority publishes the report of every run it conducts, passes and failures alike, so that a verifier can see how often a subject needed more than one run.
